title: Toward an Attentional Model of Time Discounting
abstract: arXiv:2505.13016v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper proposes a new theory of time discounting. We assume that when decision makers evaluate a sequence of future rewards, they allocate more attention to large rewards and less attention to small rewards. Moreover, when attention is distributed over a longer time horizon, each period receives less attention. The reductions in attention lead to greater discounting of reward values, and the resulting discount factors follow a distribution similar to the multinomial logit function. We characterize such discount factors using two approaches: an axiomatic analysis based on the optimal discounting framework, and a neuro-computational mechanism based on a simple spiking neural network. The theory explains a wide range of anomalies, including the hidden-zero effect, S-shaped value function, intertemporal correlation aversion, concentration bias, and inconsistent planning. translated_title: 迈向时间贴现的注意力模型
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种新的时间贴现理论。我们假设，当决策者评估一系列未来收益时，他们会将更多注意力分配给大收益，而将较少注意力分配给小收益。此外，当注意力分布在更长的时间范围内时，每个时期所获得的注意力会更少。注意力的减少导致收益价值被更大程度地贴现，由此产生的贴现因子遵循一种类似于多项logit函数的分布。我们通过两种方法来刻画这种贴现因子：基于最优贴现框架的公理化分析，以及基于简单脉冲神经网络的神经计算机制。该理论解释了广泛的异常现象，包括隐藏零效应、S形价值函数、跨期相关性厌恶、集中偏差和不一致的规划。此外，它还为若干已被充分记录的现象识别出新的决定因素。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于注意力机制的时间贴现新理论：由于决策者对小收益和远期收益分配的注意力更少，从而导致更强的贴现，由此推导出的贴现因子既能从公理化和神经计算两个角度得到刻画，又能解释隐藏零效应等多种跨期选择异常。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an attentional theory of time discounting, in which reduced attention to small rewards and to more distant periods yields stronger discounting with multinomial-logit-like discount factors, characterized axiomatically and via a spiking neural network, and explaining many intertemporal choice anomalies.
